title: Raise Engineering by 10 percent
statementMd:
Give every Engineering employee (`department_id = 1`) a 10% raise with an `UPDATE`, then report the new total payroll of the whole company rounded to 2 decimals. (Each run starts from a fresh copy of the data.)

Expected columns: `total_payroll`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Run the `UPDATE` first, then a `SELECT` in the same script.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE employees SET salary = salary * 1.10 WHERE department_id = 1; SELECT ROUND(SUM(salary), 2) AS total_payroll FROM employees;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
